tasks.subject: Task 1: Schema — CompetitorPrice model
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add the data model this feature depends on.

**Files:**
- Modify: `prisma/schema.prisma`
- Modify: `prisma/schema.production.prisma`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `CompetitorPrice` model exists with `productId` (relation to `Product`, `onDelete: Cascade`), `merchantId`, `competitorName`, `priceCents`, optional `url`, and `capturedAt` (defaults to now)
- [ ] `Product` gains a `competitorPrices CompetitorPrice[]` relation
- [ ] Both schema files stay in sync (only the `datasource` block differs)

**Verify:** `npx prisma db push && npx prisma generate` → no errors

```json:metadata
{"files": ["prisma/schema.prisma", "prisma/schema.production.prisma"], "verifyCommand": "npx prisma db push && npx prisma generate", "acceptanceCriteria": ["CompetitorPrice model exists with productId relation onDelete Cascade, merchantId, competitorName, priceCents, optional url, capturedAt default now", "Product gains competitorPrices relation", "both schema files in sync"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Extract shared market stats utility
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Move the min/median/q1/q3 stats math out of `calculateLaunchPlan.ts` into a shared, reusable module — no behavior change, but now usable by the new competitor-prices UI too.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/pricing/marketStats.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/pricing/marketStats.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/lib/launchPlanner/calculateLaunchPlan.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `calculateMarketStats(pricesCents: number[])` computes `{ minCents, maxCents, medianCents, q1Cents, q3Cents }` from a sorted ascending array — identical math to the private function it replaces
- [ ] `calculateLaunchPlan.ts` imports and uses the shared function instead of its own private copy; `LaunchMarketStats` remains importable from `calculateLaunchPlan.ts` (re-exported) so `explainLaunchPrice.ts` needs no changes
- [ ] `calculateLaunchPlan.test.ts` passes unmodified — confirms no behavior regression

**Verify:** `npm test -- src/lib/pricing/marketStats.test.ts src/lib/launchPlanner/calculateLaunchPlan.test.ts` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/pricing/marketStats.ts", "src/lib/pricing/marketStats.test.ts", "src/lib/launchPlanner/calculateLaunchPlan.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- src/lib/pricing/marketStats.test.ts src/lib/launchPlanner/calculateLaunchPlan.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["calculateMarketStats exported from new module matches prior private behavior", "calculateLaunchPlan.ts uses shared module, re-exports LaunchMarketStats type", "existing calculateLaunchPlan.test.ts passes unmodified"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Competitor price CRUD API
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Let a merchant list, add, edit, and delete competitor prices for a product they own.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/api/products/[id]/competitor-prices/route.ts`
- Test: `src/app/api/products/[id]/competitor-prices/route.test.ts`
- Create: `src/app/api/products/[id]/competitor-prices/[cpId]/route.ts`
- Test: `src/app/api/products/[id]/competitor-prices/[cpId]/route.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `GET /api/products/[id]/competitor-prices` returns rows sorted by `priceCents` ascending; 404 if product isn't owned by caller
- [ ] `POST /api/products/[id]/competitor-prices` creates a row (`competitorName`, `priceCents`, optional `url`); 400 for empty name, non-positive/non-integer price, or invalid (non-http/https) `url`
- [ ] `PATCH /api/products/[id]/competitor-prices/[cpId]` updates given fields and bumps `capturedAt`; 404 if row doesn't belong to that product/merchant
- [ ] `DELETE /api/products/[id]/competitor-prices/[cpId]` removes the row; 404 if it doesn't belong to that product/merchant

**Verify:** `npm test -- "src/app/api/products/[id]/competitor-prices"` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/api/products/[id]/competitor-prices/route.ts", "src/app/api/products/[id]/competitor-prices/route.test.ts", "src/app/api/products/[id]/competitor-prices/[cpId]/route.ts", "src/app/api/products/[id]/competitor-prices/[cpId]/route.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- \"src/app/api/products/[id]/competitor-prices\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["GET lists sorted by priceCents asc with 404 ownership check", "POST validates name/price/url and creates row", "PATCH updates fields and bumps capturedAt with 404 checks", "DELETE removes row with 404 checks"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Competitor prices card + product page wiring
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Let a merchant view, add, edit, and remove competitor prices from the product detail page, with summary stats.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/components/CompetitorPricesCard.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/product/[id]/page.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Product page shows a "Competitor prices" card alongside existing cards (`RecommendationCard`, `PriceSurveyCard`)
- [ ] Empty state message when zero rows exist
- [ ] With ≥1 row: shows min/median/max (via `calculateMarketStats`) above a table (name, price, optional link-out, captured date, remove)
- [ ] Inline add-row form creates a new row without a page reload
- [ ] A "Plan launch price →" link points to `/launch-planner?productId=<id>`

**Verify:** Manual check in the browser — add competitor prices, confirm stats/table update, confirm launch-planner link carries the product id.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/components/CompetitorPricesCard.tsx", "src/app/product/[id]/page.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "manual browser check per plan Task 4 Step 3", "acceptanceCriteria": ["card renders empty state at 0 rows", "card renders min/median/max stats and table at >=1 row", "add form creates row without reload", "Plan launch price link includes productId query param"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Launch Planner prefill from saved competitor prices
tasks.description:
**Goal:** When Launch Planner is opened with `?productId=`, prefill the existing competitor-prices field from that product's saved list.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/components/LaunchPlanner.tsx`
- Test: `src/components/LaunchPlanner.test.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] With no `productId` in the URL, behavior unchanged from today (field starts empty)
- [ ] With a `productId` that has saved competitor prices, field is prefilled with a comma-separated dollar list on mount
- [ ] If the fetch fails or returns zero rows, the field stays empty — no error state blocks the rest of the calculator

**Verify:** `npm test -- src/components/LaunchPlanner.test.tsx` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/components/LaunchPlanner.tsx", "src/components/LaunchPlanner.test.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- src/components/LaunchPlanner.test.tsx", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no productId leaves field empty, no fetch call", "productId with saved rows prefills comma-separated dollar values", "failed fetch or empty rows leaves field untouched, no blocking error"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
